source.analysis: Blutter object pool with manual Capstone ARM64 reconstruction of request builders and calling repositories/cubits
source.address_format: hexadecimal native virtual address in the exact libapp.so; .text VA and file offset begin at 0x2f0000
source.artifact_note: Artifact names identify the original private analysis notes, not files distributed with this source. The APK and disassembly are not bundled; function addresses and binary hashes preserve the technical provenance.

scope.observed: Exact request maps constructed by the Android application; no server-side requiredness or acceptance claims.

common.extra_note: accessToken is an internal Dio extra, not a query parameter or an HTTP header. Existing app interceptors add authorization.

scope.null_query_note: Categories query contains parentId:null for the root. This static recovery does not establish final URL serialization of null by Dio.
scope.response_note: Generated client methods return Dio Response. Repository parsing accesses response.data; no live response was collected.
scope.client_limits_note: Python mixin bounds page at 10000, query at 256 characters, filter count at 100 and positive IDs at signed int64. These are local validation choices, not APK/server limits.

catalog_product_detail.behavior: Normal product detail request. Input is the result object Product.itemId, despite platformItem in the endpoint name. Sends no platformId query.
